battle.name: 第七次伊孫佐戰役
battle.brief: 1915年9月，第七次伊孫佐戰役在義大利與奧匈邊境爆發，雙方在高山峡谷激烈交火。義大利軍首次大規模投入菲亞特·瑞維利M1914重機槍，以其高射速壓制奧軍防線，迫使後者陷入消耗戰。此次進攻促使雙方重新部署，並使用新型火砲加強支援。

kit.name: 菲亞特·瑞維利重機槍
kit.history: 作為義大利第一款制式氣冷重機槍，與步兵連協同作戰，主要配備於前線火力點，提供持續壓制火力。

dossier.countries: 意大利王國與奧匈帝國是第七次伊孫佐戰役的主要交戰雙方。意大利在1915年5月對奧匈帝國宣戰後，決意沿伊孫佐河發動連串攻勢，以圖突破奧匈軍在卡索高原與戈里齊亞的防線。奧匈帝國則依靠阿爾卑斯山脈的天然屏障與深溝壕塹，動員包括匈牙利、克羅地亞與波蘭裔士兵在內的多民族兵團，堅守橋頭堡與山地要塞。
dossier.countriesEn: The Kingdom of Italy and the Austro‑Hungarian Empire were the main belligerents in the seventh Battle of the Isonzo. After Italy declared war on Austria‑Hungary in May 1915, it resolved to launch a series of offensives along the Isonzo River in an attempt to break through the Austro‑Hungarian defenses on the Karst Plateau and at Gorizia. The Austro‑Hungarian Empire relied on the natural barriers of the Alps, deep trenches, and multinational forces comprising Hungarian, Croatian and Polish troops to hold bridgeheads and mountain strongholds.
dossier.people: 義大利方面由陸軍元帥路易吉·卡多爾納率領全軍策划與指揮，意大利第2軍軍長埃米利奧·帕希亞則具體督導前線師團的進攻。奧匈帝國方面，第5軍司令斯韋托扎爾·博羅耶維奇指揮防禦，另有帝國參謀總長康拉德·馮·赫岑多夫提供戰略指導，並有山地兵團指挥官约瑟夫·费尔曼率领阿尔卑斯猎兵参与防守。
dossier.peopleEn: On the Italian side, Marshal Luigi Cadorna directed overall planning and command of the army, while General Emilio Pashà of the Italian Second Army supervised the frontline divisions’ assaults. For the Austro‑Hungarian side, General Svetozar Borojević commanded the 5th Army’s defense, with Chief of the General Staff Conrad von Hötzendorf providing strategic guidance and Alpine corps commander Josef Virmont leading the Kaiserjäger in the defense.
dossier.kits: 雙方在戰役中皆投入大量當時已列裝的武器。意大利步兵主要使用卡爾卡諾M1891步槍，配備9毫米格利森蒂手槍與6.5毫米維克斯機槍；砲兵則裝備75毫米菲亞特1906野戰炮、65毫米山地炮以及149毫米M1914榴彈炮，並使用81毫米迫擊炮進行近距離壓制。奧匈帝國方面，步槍為施泰爾-曼利舍M1907步槍，手槍包括施泰爾M1912與羅特-施泰爾M1907，機槍以7.92毫米施瓦爾茲洛斯MG M.07為主，砲兵則有8厘米M1905迫擊炮、10.4厘米M1909野戰炮和15厘米M1909榴彈炮，另配有少量裝甲車與觀測氣球。
dossier.kitsEn: Both sides fielded a wide array of equipment that had been in service by 1915. Italian infantry were armed mainly with the Carcano Model 91 rifle, supplemented by the 9 mm Glisenti pistol and the 6.5 mm Vickers machine gun; artillery included the 75 mm Fiat 1906 field gun, the 65 mm mountain gun, the 149 mm Model 1914 howitzer, and the 81 mm mortar for close‑range support. The Austro‑Hungarian army used the Steyr‑Mannlicher M1907 rifle, pistols such as the Steyr M1912 and Roth‑Steyr M1907, the 7.92 mm Schwarzlose MG M.07 machine gun, 8 cm M1905 mortars, 10.4 cm M1909 field guns, and 15 cm M1909 howitzers, together with a few armored cars and observation balloons.
dossier.tactics: 第七次伊孫佐戰役的戰術以密集砲兵準備與步兵滲透相結合。意大利軍在進攻前先以75毫米與149毫米火炮進行長達兩小時的徐進彈幕，企圖削弱敵軍防線的機槍與鐵絲網；隨後，步兵以小隊形式分批向前躍進，利用山地步兵與阿爾卑斯獵兵的靈活性在峽谷中穿隙間隙。奧匈帝國則採用縱深防禦，將主防線設於河谷高地，配合多層鐵絲網與機槍巢，並在必要時調動預備隊實施逆襲，以抵消意大利的突破口。
dossier.tacticsEn: The tactics of the seventh Battle of the Isonzo combined heavy artillery preparation with infantry infiltration. Italian forces preceded their assault with a two‑hour creeping barrage from 75 mm and 149 mm guns, aiming to suppress enemy machine‑gun nests and cut barbed wire; afterward, infantry advanced in small squads, exploiting the agility of Alpine troops to slip through gaps in the valleys. The Austro‑Hungarian side employed deep defence, siting the main line on the high ground above the river, layering barbed wire and machine‑gun emplacements, and using reserve units for counter‑attacks to seal any breach.
dossier.data: 第七次伊孫佐戰役於1915年9月14日展開，至同月17日結束，歷時四天。意大利軍在四天的激烈戰鬥中投入約第2軍與第3軍共八個師，總兵力逾十二萬人；奥匈帝國則動員第5軍及若干後備師，兵力約十萬。根據史料，意大利在此次攻勢中傷亡約三萬人，其中約一萬人陣亡；奥匈帝國損失約二萬人，含約七千名士兵陣亡。雙方在戰役中佔領的土地相當有限，僅在河左岸的幾個小山丘上取得了小幅度的進展。
dossier.dataEn: The seventh Battle of the Isonzo began on 14 September 1915 and ended on 17 September 1915, lasting four days. Italy committed roughly eight divisions of the 2nd and 3rd Armies, totalling over 120,000 men; the Austro‑Hungarian forces deployed the 5th Army and several reserve divisions, about 100,000 troops. Historical records indicate that Italian casualties amounted to roughly 30,000 men, including about 10,000 dead; Austro‑Hungarian losses were around 20,000, with roughly 7,000 killed. Territorial gains were minimal, with only a few hillocks on the left bank of the river changing hands.
dossier.cause: 第七次伊孫佐戰役的根本動因在於意大利欲突破奧匈帝國在伊孫佐河的防線，奪取戰略要地戈里齊亞，進而威脅奧匈帝國的心臟地區。自1915年5月意大利參戰後，軍方高層相信透過接連的消耗戰可以削弱敵軍的抵抗能力，因而決定在短時間內連續發動第七次大規模攻勢，以圖在秋季前取得決定性突破。
dossier.causeEn: The fundamental cause of the seventh Battle of the Isonzo was Italy’s determination to breach the Austro‑Hungarian lines along the Isonzo, capture the strategic town of Gorizia, and threaten the heartland of the Habsburg Empire. After Italy entered the war in May 1915, the high command believed that a series of attritional assaults would wear down the enemy, prompting the decision to launch another major offensive within a short timeframe, hoping to achieve a decisive breakthrough before the onset of autumn.
dossier.impact: 第七次伊孫佐戰役的結果對雙方的士氣與後續作戰計畫均產生深遠影響。意大利雖然未能在防線上取得決定性突破，但通過此次血戰檢驗了新式砲兵與山地步兵的協同作战能力，並迫使奧匈帝國在伊孫佐河沿線集結大量兵力，削弱了其在卡波雷托方向的防守厚度。此役的慘重傷亡亦使意大利公眾與軍隊內部開始質疑高層的消耗戰策略，促使後續的指揮體系進行局部調整。
dossier.impactEn: The impact of the seventh Battle of the Isonzo was profound for both sides’ morale and subsequent operations. Although Italy failed to achieve a decisive breakthrough, the battle tested the combined use of modern artillery and Alpine infantry, compelling Austria‑Hungary to concentrate large forces along the Isonzo, thereby thinning its defenses elsewhere, such as at Caporetto. The heavy casualties also sparked criticism within the Italian public and army regarding the high‑command’s attritional strategy, leading to modest adjustments in the command structure thereafter.
dossier.result: 第七次伊孫佐戰役最終以雙方均未能取得決定性勝利告終。意大利軍在激烈的四天交戰後僅佔領了河左岸的數處高地，付出的代價卻是約三萬人的傷亡；奧匈帝國則成功守住主要防線，損失亦約二萬人。雖然戰役未改變整體前線格局，但雙方在兵力與物資上的損耗為後續的第八、第九次伊孫佐戰役以及最終的卡波雷托突破奠定了基礎。
dossier.resultEn: The seventh Battle of the Isonzo concluded without a decisive victory for either side. After four days of fierce fighting Italy held only a few hillocks on the left bank, at the cost of roughly 30,000 casualties; Austria‑Hungary maintained its main defensive line, losing about 20,000 men. Though the battle did not alter the overall front, the heavy loss of men and material set the stage for the subsequent eighth and ninth Battles of the Isonzo and ultimately the breakthrough at Caporetto.

battle.name: 俄國內戰
battle.brief: 俄國內戰（1917–1922）係布爾什維克紅軍與白軍、外國干涉軍及邊區武裝之間的全面衝突，戰場遍及俄羅斯歐洲部分、西伯利亞與遠東。紅軍主力步槍為莫辛-納甘M1891，已於1891年列裝，裝甲列車同鐵路車站比坦克更決定能否把下一列車彈藥送上前線。

kit.name: 莫辛-納甘M1891步槍
kit.history: 1891年已列裝的栓式步槍，一次大戰同內戰都係紅軍同白軍的底子。內戰裡決定鐵路樞紐的係機槍、野砲同裝甲列車，唔係呢支槍的改型。

dossier.countries: 俄國內戰由1917年11月7日打到1922年10月25日，遠東殘部到1923年6月，不是打到2022年。戰場不是一座城，而是歐洲俄羅斯、頓河、伏爾加河、西伯利亞大鐵路同海參崴。紅軍守住莫斯科同彼得格勒呢條內線。白軍由南面鄧尼金、東面高爾察克、西北面尤登尼奇、最後克里米亞嘅弗蘭格爾分頭打入來。英、法、美、日都派過干涉部隊，日本留到1922年先離開海參崴。邊區仲有芬蘭、波蘭、烏克蘭、高加索自己嘅政府。莫斯科約北緯55.75度、東經37.62度。誰佔住車站，誰先送得出下一列車嘅彈同糧。
dossier.countriesEn: The Russian Civil War ran from 7 November 1917 to 25 October 1922, with a Far East remnant into June 1923. It did not run to 2022. The ground was European Russia, the Don, the Volga, the Trans-Siberian Railway and Vladivostok, not one city. The Reds held the interior around Moscow and Petrograd. The Whites came in from Denikin in the south, Kolchak in the east, Yudenich in the northwest, and Wrangel last in Crimea. Britain, France, the United States and Japan intervened. Japan stayed until it left Vladivostok in 1922. Finland, Poland, Ukraine and the Caucasus had their own governments. Moscow sits near 55.75 N, 37.62 E. Whoever held the station could send the next train of ammunition and grain.
dossier.people: 列寧抓政權，托洛茨基把紅軍編成可以調動嘅常備軍，軍部就設喺一列裝甲列車上面，政委跟住每個單位走。布瓊尼帶第一騎兵軍，伏龍芝後來改紅軍嘅打法，捷爾任斯基掌契卡，圖哈切夫斯基係年輕指揮官，1937年先被清洗。白軍冇統一參謀部。高爾察克1920年1月15日喺伊爾庫茨克被俘，其後被處決。鄧尼金1920年3月26至27日由新羅西斯克撤出。弗蘭格爾守到1920年11月14至16日先離開克里米亞。尤登尼奇1919年10月打到彼得格勒外圍。科爾尼洛夫1918年4月已死，米勒守北方阿爾漢格爾斯克。捷克斯洛伐克軍團大約5萬到6萬人，1918年沿鐵路同當地蘇維埃打起，打開東線。馬赫諾喺烏克蘭同兩邊都打過。
dossier.peopleEn: Lenin held the state. Trotsky turned the Red Army into a force that could be moved, and kept his headquarters on an armoured train, with a commissar in each unit. Budyonny led the 1st Cavalry Army. Frunze later rewrote Red method. Dzerzhinsky ran the Cheka. Tukhachevsky was a young commander, later purged in 1937. The Whites never shared one staff. Kolchak was captured at Irkutsk on 15 January 1920 and then executed. Denikin left Novorossiysk on 26–27 March 1920. Wrangel held Crimea until 14–16 November 1920. Yudenich reached the edge of Petrograd in October 1919. Kornilov was already dead in April 1918. Miller held the north at Arkhangelsk. The Czechoslovak Legion, about 50,000 to 60,000 men, clashed with local soviets along the railway in 1918 and opened the eastern front. Makhno in Ukraine fought both sides.
dossier.kits: 雙方嘅底子都係莫辛-納甘M1891，1891年已經列裝，唔係後來嘅改型故事。白軍同干涉軍另外用英國李-恩菲爾德同西伯利亞嘅三八式。機槍先至係步兵嘅決定火力：馬克沁M1910水冷、大約每分鐘600發，劉易斯俾白軍同干涉軍用，MG08係1918年喺烏克蘭繳獲嘅德國槍。火砲主力係76.2毫米M1902野戰砲，122毫米榴彈砲做重支援，砲彈長期唔夠，要靠火車運上前線。裝甲列車先係呢場仗嘅招牌。紅軍到1920年大約有100列以上可以打仗，白軍喺西伯利亞都用。坦克少，紅軍到1920年大約100架，多數係繳獲嘅英國Mark V同法國雷諾FT，易壞，嚇到人多過打穿陣地。飛機大約300到400架，同樣多數係繳獲，索普威斯同紐波特做偵察同輕轟炸，未有制空權打法。裝甲車用民用底盤改，化學砲彈1919年兩邊都用過，唔係決定因素。波羅的海艦隊多半凍住或者嘩變，黑海艦隊1920年喺新羅西斯克自沉。
dossier.kitsEn: Both sides lived on the Mosin-Nagant M1891, in service since 1891, not on a later variant story. Whites and intervention troops also used the British Lee-Enfield and the Arisaka in Siberia. The machine gun decided infantry fire: the water-cooled Maxim M1910 at about 600 rounds a minute, the Lewis with the Whites and intervention forces, and the MG08 captured in Ukraine in 1918. The gun line was the 76.2mm M1902 field gun, with 122mm howitzers behind it. Shells stayed short, so trains carried the guns. Armoured trains were the signature. The Reds had more than 100 that could fight by 1920, and the Whites used them in Siberia. Tanks were few. The Reds had about 100 by 1920, mostly captured British Mark V and French Renault FT. They broke down, and they scared more than they broke a line. Aircraft ran about 300 to 400, mostly captured Sopwiths and Nieuports, used for reconnaissance and light bombing, with no air-superiority method yet. Armoured cars were civilian chassis with plate. Gas shells were used by both sides in 1919 and did not decide the war. The Baltic Fleet was mostly iced in or mutinous. The Black Sea Fleet was scuttled at Novorossiysk in 1920.
dossier.tactics: 呢場唔係壕對壕。白軍由外線三路打入來，紅軍用內線把師由一個戰場塞去另一個戰場。1919年高爾察克3月由東面進，鄧尼金7月由南面迫莫斯科，尤登尼奇10月打到彼得格勒外圍，三路之間冇統一命令，紅軍就逐路打回頭。打法係先佔車站同橋，再談進城。托洛茨基嘅政委制把命令由列車傳落到連。宣傳列車帶印刷機同擴音器，白軍冇同等嘅一套。無線電有，但唔穩，信差同列車仍然係主線。徵糧同兵源比一次城市衝鋒更決定仲可以打幾個月。彈藥斷咗，人數仲在都會退出。
dossier.tacticsEn: This was not trench against trench. The Whites attacked from the rim on three axes. The Reds shifted divisions inside that rim. In 1919 Kolchak advanced from the east in March, Denikin pressed Moscow from the south in July, and Yudenich reached the edge of Petrograd in October. The three axes had no common order, so the Reds beat them one at a time. The method was to take the station and the bridge before the town. Trotsky's commissars carried the order from the train down to the company. Agitprop trains carried presses and loudspeakers. The Whites had no matching set. Radio existed and was unreliable. Couriers and trains remained the line. Grain and recruits outlasted one city assault. When the ammunition stopped, the numbers still on the roll left the field.
dossier.data: 主要戰事喺1918到1920年，海參崴1922年10月25日易手，蘇聯1922年12月30日成立。紅軍1920年巔峰大約500萬動員、大約300萬野戰。白軍三路加埋巔峰大約25萬到30萬：高爾察克大約10萬到13萬，鄧尼金大約15萬，尤登尼奇大約2萬到2.5萬，弗蘭格爾大約5萬到6萬。干涉軍各國加埋巔峰超過20萬，日本大約7萬，法、英各大約4萬，美國大約1.3萬。布瓊尼第一騎兵軍大約1.6萬到2萬。死亡同饑荒以百萬計，常見範圍大約700萬到1200萬，包戰死、恐怖、饑荒同瘟疫，各家差好遠，這裡不編成一個假總數。1921到22年饑荒大約500萬，係估算。紅色恐怖處決常見範圍大約5萬到20萬，白色恐怖規模相近而記載更少。feed若寫1918到2022，係把年份接錯。
dossier.dataEn: The main fighting was 1918 to 1920. Vladivostok changed hands on 25 October 1922. The Soviet Union was founded on 30 December 1922. The Red Army peaked in 1920 at about 5 million mobilized and about 3 million in the field. The Whites on all fronts peaked at about 250,000 to 300,000: Kolchak about 100,000 to 130,000, Denikin about 150,000, Yudenich about 20,000 to 25,000, Wrangel about 50,000 to 60,000. Intervention troops peaked above 200,000, Japan about 70,000, France and Britain about 40,000 each, the United States about 13,000. Budyonny's 1st Cavalry Army was about 16,000 to 20,000. Deaths and famine ran into the millions. A common range is about 7 to 12 million, covering combat, terror, famine and disease. The exact total is disputed, so it is not invented here. The 1921–22 famine is estimated near 5 million. Red Terror executions are commonly put at about 50,000 to 200,000. White Terror was a similar scale and less documented. A feed line that says 1918–2022 has joined the wrong years.
dossier.cause: 1917年舊政權垮咗，布爾什維克奪權，舊軍官、地方同外國政府唔肯認。捷克斯洛伐克軍團原本想沿西伯利亞鐵路去法國，1918年同當地蘇維埃打起，東線先打開。動員唔係一張表，係鐵路仲可以將邊個送上前線。白軍把土地問題押後到打完先算，紅軍就用土地歸農民同單一指揮對住佢哋。冇呢一次奪權，就冇呢場內戰。冇鐵路，呢場內戰打唔成而家呢個形狀。
dossier.causeEn: The old regime collapsed in 1917. The Bolsheviks took power. Former officers, local governments and foreign governments refused to accept it. The Czechoslovak Legion had meant to ride the Trans-Siberian toward France. In 1918 it fought local soviets, and the eastern front opened. Mobilisation was not a table. It was whether the railway could still send a man forward. The Whites deferred the land question until after the war. The Reds answered with land to the peasants and one command. Without that seizure of power there is no civil war. Without the railway the war does not take this shape.
dossier.impact: 紅軍由呢場仗做成常備軍。政委、宣傳列車同徵糧機器都係打緊先成型，唔係戰後先發明。國內幾乎冇自己嘅坦克廠同飛機廠，打完先研究繳獲嘅雷諾FT，第一款蘇聯坦克MS-1要到1927年。蘇聯嘅邊界同一黨國家唔係喺宣言裡長出嚟，係白軍失敗之後留低。干涉冇打出一個可以執政嘅白軍政府，只留低港口同軍火嘅帳單。
dossier.impactEn: The Red Army became a standing force in this war. Commissars, agitprop trains and the grain-requisition machine took shape while the fighting was on, not after it. There was almost no domestic tank or aircraft plant. Captured Renault FTs were studied after the war. The first Soviet tank, the MS-1, came in 1927. The Soviet border and the one-party state were what remained after the Whites failed. Intervention did not produce a White government that could rule. It left a bill for ports and munitions.
dossier.result: 紅軍勝。白軍主力到1920年失敗，弗蘭格爾由克里米亞撤出，日本1922年10月離開海參崴。勝負係邊個留喺車站，唔係邊個嘅故事更好聽。蘇聯1922年12月30日成立，係呢場仗留低嘅國家，唔係另一場仗。
dossier.resultEn: The Reds won. The main White armies were beaten by 1920, Wrangel left Crimea, and Japan left Vladivostok in October 1922. The result is who still held the stations, not whose story sounds better. The Soviet Union founded on 30 December 1922 is the state this war left, not another war.

battle.name: 西班牙內戰
battle.brief: 西班牙內戰在1936年7月爆發後，共和派與國民軍在馬德里、巴塞隆納、格蘭納達等城市以及北部山區形成激烈的前線。蘇聯提供的T-26輕型坦克在共和軍的機械化單位中被部署，用以支援步兵突破並在城市防守中提供有限的裝甲火力。

kit.name: T-26輕型坦克
kit.history: 作為共和軍的主力輕型坦克，T-26在西班牙內戰中於城市防守與機動支援中提供裝甲火力。

dossier.countries: 西班牙內戰的根本陣營分為兩大對立陣營：一方為第二共和國政府及其支持的左翼政黨、工會與武裝民兵，稱為共和派；另一方為以弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥為首的國民軍（亦稱民族派），結合了傳統軍官、保守派貴族、教會勢力以及極端的法西斯黨派——法西斯主義的長槍黨與卡洛斯派的卡洛斯主義者。戰爭期間，外國勢力的介入極大地塑造了雙方的軍事格局。納粹德國與法西斯意大利向國民軍提供了大量的機械化裝備、空軍與軍事顧問，並組織了「秃鷹軍團」在西班牙作戰；葡萄牙的萨拉查政權亦提供了物資與志願兵。另一方面，蘇聯與墨西哥則向共和派輸送了戰鬥機、坦克、火炮及軍事顧問，並在國際縱隊的名義下召集了來自法國、英國、美國、德國、波蘭等國的志願者加入前線。
dossier.countriesEn: The fundamental camps of the Spanish Civil War were divided into two major opposing sides: on one side stood the Second Republic government and its leftist parties, unions and armed militia, collectively referred to as the Republicans; on the other side were the Nationalist insurgents led by Francisco Franco, combining traditional officers, conservative aristocracy, church forces and the extreme fascist Falange and the Carlist carlists. During the war, foreign interventions greatly shaped the military configuration of both sides. Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy supplied the Nationalists with large quantities of mechanised equipment, air support and military advisors, and organized the Condor Legion to fight in Spain; Portugal's Salazar regime also provided materiel and volunteers. On the other side, the Soviet Union and Mexico delivered fighters, tanks, artillery and military advisors to the Republicans, and under the banner of the International Brigades recruited volunteers from France, Britain, the United States, Germany, Poland and other countries to join the front lines.
dossier.people: 在這場武裝衝突中，雙方均有眾多具有代表性的軍事與政治領袖。國民軍方面，弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥元帥於1936年9月被任命為最高統帥，指揮非洲軍團以及後續的北上進攻；何塞·莫斯卡多將軍率領特種步兵營，負責保衛重要的港口城市；胡安·亞格將軍以其在西班牙外籍軍團的作戰經驗，指揮快速突破的機械化縱隊；岡薩洛·克波·德·利亞諾在塞維利亞的廣播宣傳與軍事行動中扮演關鍵角色。共和派方面，荷西·米亞哈將軍在馬德里防禦戰中成為核心指揮官，率領正規軍與武裝群眾共同抵禦包圍；共產黨領袖多洛雷斯·伊巴露麗以其激昂的演說激勵前線士兵；無政府主義領袖布埃娜文圖拉·杜羅提與弗朗西斯科·阿斯卡西則率領武裝工人游擊隊在城市與鄉村展開游擊戰；國際縱隊的軍事顧問如安德烈·馬蒂（法國）與沃爾特·馮·托馬（德國）亦在戰術策劃上提供寶貴經驗。
dossier.peopleEn: On both sides of the armed conflict there were many representative military and political leaders. Among the Nationalists, Field Marshal Francisco Franco was appointed Supreme Commander in September 1936 and directed the Army of Africa and the subsequent north‑ward offensive; General José Moscardó led special infantry battalions guarding key port cities; General Juan Yagüe, drawing on his experience with the Spanish Legion, commanded rapid‑moving mechanised columns; General Gonzalo Queipo de Llano played a crucial role in both the radio propaganda and military operations in Seville. On the Republican side, General José Miaja became the core commander during the defense of Madrid, leading regular troops and armed civilians together; Communist leader Dolores Ibárruri inspired frontline soldiers with her impassioned speeches; anarchist leaders Buenaventura Durruti and Francisco Ascaso headed armed worker guerrillas fighting in cities and countryside; International Brigades' military advisors such as André Marty of France and Walter von Thoma of Germany also contributed valuable experience to tactical planning.
dossier.kits: 裝備方面，交戰雙方使用的武器與車輛均屬1930年代中期已列裝的真實型號。國民軍的步兵主要配備德國製造的毛瑟98步槍（口徑7.92×57mm），機槍則包括MG 13與MG 08/15，口徑同為7.92mm；火力支援依賴於10.5 cm leIG 18步兵炮與15 cm sIG 33重型步兵炮；坦克部隊則裝甲了德國的Panzer I A型（裝甲厚度13mm）與Panzer II（武裝20mm機炮），以及義大利的CV-33裝甲車；空軍方面，國民軍使用Heinkel He 51戰鬥機、Fiat CR.32與Ju 52轟炸機，並在1937年引入Messerschmitt Bf 109（初期為Bf 109B）。共和派的武器則以蘇聯提供的主力裝備為主：步槍使用7.62×54mm的莫辛-納干步槍；機槍包括DP-27輕機槍與M1910馬克沁重機槍；火炮則配備76.2 mm F-22野戰炮與122 mm howitzer；坦克則裝甲了蘇聯T-26（口徑45mm炮）與BT-5快速坦克；空軍則使用Polikarpov I-16單翼戰鬥機與Polikarpov R-5偵察機，並接受了少量義大利製的Saia-Marchetti SM.79轟炸機。所有武器與車輛均已在1936年前列裝，確保了雙方在技術層面的真實可比性。
dossier.kitsEn: In terms of equipment, the weapons and vehicles used by both combatants were real models that had entered service in the mid‑1930s. Nationalist infantry were principally equipped with the German Mauser 98 rifle (7.92×57 mm), while machine guns included the MG 13 and the MG 08/15, also chambered for 7.92 mm; fire support relied on the 10.5 cm leIG 18 infantry gun and the 15 cm sIG 33 heavy infantry gun; tank units were armored with German Panzer I Ausf. A (13 mm armor) and Panzer II (armed with a 20 mm cannon), as well as Italian CV‑33 armored cars; in the air, the Nationalists flew Heinkel He 51 fighters, Fiat CR.32 fighters and Ju 52 bombers, and began receiving Messerschmitt Bf 109 (initially the Bf 109B) in 1937. Republican weapons were mainly supplied by the Soviet Union: rifles were the 7.62×54 mm Mosin‑Nagant; machine guns comprised the DP‑27 light machine gun and the M1910 Maxim heavy machine gun; artillery included the 76.2 mm F‑22 field gun and 122 mm howitzers; tanks were the Soviet T‑26 (equipped with a 45 mm gun) and BT‑5 fast tanks; the air force used the Polikarpov I‑16 monoplane fighter and the Polikarpov R‑5 reconnaissance aircraft, and received a limited number of Italian‑built Savoia‑Marchetti SM.79 bombers. All weapons and vehicles had been listed in service before 1936, ensuring genuine comparability between the two sides.
dossier.tactics: 在戰術層面，國民軍採用了以機械化縱隊為核心的快速突破與分割包圍戰術。1936年9月，佛朗哥率領非洲軍團從摩洛哥北上，結合德國Panzer I與義大利CV-33裝甲車，在托萊多與埃斯特雷馬杜拉之間形成快速穿插線；同時，德國空軍的Heinkel He 51與Ju 52提供近距離空中支援，壓制共和派的防線。國民軍的炮兵則以10.5 cm leIG 18與15 cm sIG 33在步兵衝擊前進行地毯式轟炸，以削弱防守陣地。相較之下，共和派最初依賴游擊式的武裝群眾與城市守備隊，採用分散的小股兵力在街巷、工廠與山區構築防禦工事；在馬德里保衛戰中，共和軍在市區部署了由志願兵組成的「人民兵團」，以街壘、手榴彈與DP-27機槍抵禦國民軍的坦克。隨著戰爭的推進，共和派在1937年接受了蘇聯顧問的正規化改造，將原有的民兵整編為步兵師與炮兵團，開始實行正規的防線構築與集中的火力支援，並在巴塞羅那與華倫西亞建立持久的後勤供應線。此後，雙方在布列塔尼（Berlín）與埃布羅河的攻防中，展示了陣地戰與渡河戰的典型模式。
dossier.tacticsEn: At the tactical level, the Nationalists employed a rapid‑breakthrough and encirclement doctrine centred on mechanised columns. In September 1936, Franco led the Army of Africa northwards from Morocco, combining German Panzer I and Italian CV‑33 armoured cars to create fast‑moving thrusts between Toledo and Extremadura, while German Luftwaffe He 51 and Ju 52 aircraft provided close‑air support to suppress Republican positions. Nationalist artillery, using the 10.5 cm leIG 18 and 15 cm sIG 33, delivered carpet‑type bombardments ahead of infantry assaults to weaken defensive positions. By contrast, the Republicans initially relied on guerrilla‑style armed civilians and urban defense units, deploying small, dispersed forces to build barricades in streets, factories and mountainous terrain. During the defence of Madrid, Republican troops formed “people’s militia” units that fought with hand‑grenades, DP‑27 machine guns and improvised explosives to repulse Nationalist tanks. As the war progressed, the Republicans, advised by Soviet specialists, reorganised their militia into regular infantry divisions and artillery regiments, adopting conventional trench construction and concentrated fire support, and established sustained supply lines around Barcelona and Valencia. Subsequently, both sides demonstrated classic positional warfare and river‑crossing tactics in the battles of the Brunete salient and the Ebro River.
dossier.data: 根據現有的歷史統計，戰爭開始時國民軍在非洲集結約80,000至100,000名士兵，加上在本土的起義軍，總兵力約在150,000人左右；共和派的武裝力量在同時期約有200,000名志願民兵與正規軍。隨著1937年的大規模動員，雙方兵力均膨脹至接近100萬人，形成了大規模的正面交戰與持久消耗的局面。主要戰役時間表如下：1936年7月18日至20日的武裝起義與摩洛哥的起義；1936年8月托萊多與巴塞羅那的激烈巷戰；1936年9月佛朗哥被任命為最高統帥；1936年11月8日馬德里保衛戰正式展開，直至1939年3月28日馬德里陷落；1937年2月的雅拉馬河戰役；1937年3月的瓜達拉哈拉會戰；1937年4月26日的格蘭尼卡轟炸；1937年7月的布朗內特攻勢；1937年9月的貝爾奇特鎮爭奪；1938年7月至11月的埃布羅河大反攻；以及1939年3月的最終突破與投降。傷亡方面，根據多數史學家的估算，整體死亡人數在30萬至50萬人之間，其中包括大量的軍事人員與因戰鬥導致的間接死亡。
dossier.dataEn: According to existing historical statistics, at the outbreak of the war the Nationalists had assembled roughly 80,000‑100,000 men in Africa, together with insurgents on the peninsula, bringing their total to about 150,000 troops; the Republican armed forces at the same time comprised about 200,000 volunteer militiamen and regular soldiers. With the massive mobilisations of 1937, both sides expanded to close to one million men, resulting in large‑scale frontal engagements and prolonged attrition. The principal chronological milestones are as follows: the military uprisings of 17‑20 July 1936 in Morocco, Cadiz, Seville and Zaragoza; intense street fighting in Toledo and Barcelona in August 1936; Franco’s appointment as Supreme Commander in September 1936; the formal commencement of the Siege of Madrid on 8 November 1936, lasting until the city fell on 28 March 1939; the Battle of the Jarama River in February 1937; the Battle of Guadalajara in March 1937; the bombing of Guernica on 26 April 1937; the Republican offensive at Brunete in July 1937; the struggle for Belchite in September 1937; the large‑scale Ebro counter‑offensive from July to November 1938; and the final breakthrough and surrender in March 1939. In terms of casualties, most historians estimate total deaths in the range of 300,000‑500,000, a figure that includes a large proportion of military personnel and indirect losses caused by combat.
dossier.cause: 西班牙內戰的起因根植於1930年代初期的政治與社會危機。1931年宣布成立的第二共和國推行土地改革、教育的世俗化以及軍隊的去政治化等措施，引發了保守派與教會勢力的激烈反對；經濟大蕭條導致農業與工業產出大幅下降，失業率飆升，城鄉矛盾加劇。左翼政黨如共產黨與無政府主義的西班牙工人階級聯盟（CNT-FAI）組織罷工與武裝暴動；右翼方面，以长枪党為代表的法西斯組織與傳統軍官階層在軍隊內部形成祕密同盟，計畫以軍事政變推翻共和國。1936年2月的議會選舉中，人民陣線以微弱多數勝出，隨即展開激進的改革與對軍隊的清洗，刺激了軍官們的叛亂決心。軍官們以保護西班牙「傳統價值」與「國家統一」為口號，於1936年7月17日至18日在摩洛哥、加的斯、塞維利亞與薩拉戈薩等地發動叛亂，標誌著內戰的正式爆發。外國法西斯政權對叛亂者提供軍事援助，使得衝突迅速升級為代理戰爭。
dossier.causeEn: The origins of the Spanish Civil War lay in the political and social crisis of the early 1930s. The Second Republic, proclaimed in 1931, introduced agrarian reform, the secularisation of education and the depoliticisation of the army, provoking fierce opposition from conservative and ecclesiastical circles; the Great Depression caused a dramatic fall in agricultural and industrial output, soaring unemployment and heightened urban‑rural tensions. Left‑wing parties such as the Communist Party and the anarchist CNT‑FAI organized strikes and armed uprisings, while on the right the Falange and traditional officer corps forged a secret alliance within the army, planning a coup to overthrow the Republic. In the February 1936 parliamentary elections, the Popular Front won a narrow majority and promptly launched radical reforms together with a purge of the armed forces, spurring the conspirators’ resolve to rebel. Officers proclaimed the defence of Spain’s “traditional values” and “national unity,” and on 17‑18 July 1936 launched uprisings in Morocco, Cadiz, Seville, Zaragoza and other cities, marking the formal outbreak of civil war. Foreign fascist regimes provided military aid to the rebels, turning the conflict into a proxy war.
dossier.impact: 內戰對西班牙及其國際格局留下了深遠的影響。首先，戰爭造成了巨大的人員傷亡與物質破壞，估計死亡人數在30萬至50萬之間，導致大批知識分子、藝術家與科學家流亡至法國、墨西哥與蘇聯，其中不少人在 exile 中繼續從事反法西斯與文化創作，對後世的西班牙文學與藝術產生深遠影響。其次，佛朗哥在戰後建立了以個人崇拜為核心的獨裁政權，實施長期的政治迫害與新聞檢查，壓制一切反對聲音，並在二戰期間與軸心國保持有限度的合作，維持西班牙的中立直到戰後。再次，戰爭成為歐洲各國政治立場的試金石，德國與意大利利用西班牙內戰測試新式武器與戰術，如坦克與空中轟炸；而蘇聯則借此機會向共產國際展示其軍事與意識形態輸出能力。西班牙內戰還催生了大量的戰爭文學與藝術作品，特別是巴勃羅·畢加索的油畫《格蘭尼卡》成為反戰的象徵，並在國際社會引發了對法西斯主義的道德譴責。最後，內戰的結果預示了二戰期間游擊戰與城市游擊戰的戰略演變，並對後續的冷戰格局產生影響，因為西班牙的獨裁體制成為西方陣營在意識形態上的一個缺口。
dossier.impactEn: The civil war left a profound imprint on Spain and the international scene. First, it caused enormous loss of life and material destruction, with death tolls estimated between 300,000 and 500,000, and forced a massive exile of intellectuals, artists and scientists to France, Mexico and the Soviet Union, many of whom continued anti‑fascist work and cultural production abroad, deeply influencing post‑war Spanish literature and art. Secondly, Franco established a personal‑cult dictatorship after the war, imposing long‑term political persecution, press censorship and the suppression of all opposition, and during World War II maintained limited cooperation with the Axis powers while keeping Spain neutral until the post‑war period. The war also served as a testing ground for European powers: Germany and Italy used it to field‑test new weapons and tactics such as tanks and strategic bombing, while the Soviet Union showcased its military and ideological export capability to the Comintern. The conflict generated a wealth of war literature and art, notably Pablo Picasso’s mural “Guernica,” which became an anti‑war symbol and provoked international moral condemnation of fascism. Finally, the Spanish conflict foreshadowed the guerrilla and urban warfare strategies of World War II and influenced the Cold‑War balance, as Spain’s dictatorship became an ideological gap in the Western camp that the United States and Western Europe later embraced in the anti‑Soviet strategy.
dossier.result: 最終，國民軍於1939年3月28日攻陷馬德里，標誌著西班牙內戰的正式結束，佛朗哥隨即成立「國防委員會」與「臨時政府」，將所有政黨解散，並以「單一黨」长枪党為唯一合法政治組織，建立起持續至1975年的長達三十六年之久的法西斯獨裁政權。戰後的西班牙在政治上實行了嚴厲的清洗與鎮壓，數以千計的前共和派官員、軍人與知識分子被處決或監禁，經濟則在國家干預與自給自足的政策下逐步恢復，但伴隨著長期的生活水平低點與國際孤立。外交上，佛朗哥在二戰初期保持「非交戰」立場，與軸心國保持有限的經濟與軍事往來，卻未正式加入軸心國，從而在戰後得以在國際社會中維持一定的生存空間。1945年後，隨著冷戰的加劇，美國與西歐國家對西班牙的獨裁政權逐漸轉變為「遏制蘇聯」戰略中的盟友，提供了經濟援助與軍事合作，進一步延長了佛朗哥政權的存續。直至1975年佛朗哥逝世，西班牙在過渡時期實行了民主改革，建立了君主立憲制，結束了長期的專制統治。整體而言，西班牙內戰的結果不僅決定了西班牙的政治走向，也深刻影響了20世紀歐洲的法西斯主義、共產主義與民主運動之間的力量對比。
dossier.resultEn: In the end, the Nationalists captured Madrid on 28 March 1939, marking the official conclusion of the Spanish Civil War. Franco immediately formed a “Junta de Defensa” and a “provisional government,” dissolved all political parties, and, with the Falange as the sole legal party, established a fascist dictatorship that lasted until his death in 1975, a span of thirty‑six years. The post‑war period was characterised by severe purges and repression: thousands of former Republican officials, soldiers and intellectuals were executed or imprisoned, while the economy was rebuilt under state‑directed autarkic policies, resulting in prolonged low living standards and international isolation. Diplomatic‑ly, Franco initially kept Spain “non‑belligerent” during World War II, maintaining limited economic and military contacts with the Axis yet refraining from formal entry, which allowed the regime to survive the post‑war years. After 1945, as the Cold War intensified, the United States and Western European nations shifted their stance, viewing Spain as a useful ally against the Soviet Union and providing economic aid and military cooperation, further extending the regime’s lifespan. Only after Franco’s death in 1975 did Spain undergo a democratic transition, establishing a constitutional monarchy and ending decades of authoritarian rule. In sum, the outcome of the Spanish Civil War determined Spain’s political trajectory and profoundly reshaped the balance between fascism, communism and democracy in 20th‑century Europe.

battle.name: 太平洋戰爭
battle.brief: 太平洋戰爭自1941年12月展開後，美軍在島嶼登陸與岸上推進中投入已列裝的M4A3E8謝爾曼坦克，以75毫米主砲與寬履帶懸吊支援步兵壓制坑道與岸防火點，並在灘頭之後的短促機動中掩護步兵向內陸推進。

kit.name: M4A3E8謝爾曼坦克
kit.history: 1944年列裝的美軍中型坦克後期型，配屬太平洋登陸部隊，負責近距火力支援與突破岸防工事。

battle.name: 韓戰
battle.brief: 1950年6月，韓戰在朝鮮半島爆發，聯合國軍與北韓及中國人民志願軍在三八線南北反覆爭奪。美軍投入已列裝的M26潘興坦克，以90毫米主砲支援步兵突破陣地並對抗對方T-34。

kit.name: M26潘興坦克
kit.history: 1944年列裝的美軍重型坦克，韓戰期間配屬地面部隊，用於近距火力支援與對抗對方中型坦克。

battle.name: 波斯灣戰爭
battle.brief: 1990年8月伊拉克出兵科威特，波斯灣戰爭隨之展開。多國聯軍在空中與地面作戰中投入已列裝的M1A1主力戰車，以120毫米主砲支援裝甲突擊，突破對方陣地並掩護步兵推進。

kit.name: M1A1主力戰車
kit.history: 1985年列裝的美軍主力戰車，1991年地面作戰期間配屬聯軍裝甲部隊，用於前線突擊與對抗對方戰車。

battle.name: 第一次世界大戰
battle.brief: 西線戰場以密集的塹壕體系為主，雙方在漫長的戰壕中進行持久的消耗戰。德軍在此戰爭中大量使用MG 08重機槍，以其高射速壓制敵方步兵並防守陣地，發揮了關鍵的火力支援作用。

kit.name: MG 08重機槍
kit.history: MG 08在一次大戰的西線和東線被廣泛部署，其持續的火力在防守與進攻中均發揮了重要作用。

battle.name: 波蘇戰爭
battle.brief: 1919年2月起，波蘭軍與蘇俄紅軍在東歐交戰，波軍投入已列裝的雷諾FT輕坦克支援步兵推進。該車以短砲塔火力掩護部隊通過開闊地，並與紅軍步兵及裝甲車對峙。

kit.name: 雷諾FT輕坦克
kit.history: 1917年已列裝的輕坦克，波蘇戰爭期間配屬波蘭裝甲單位，用於步兵支援與短促機動。

battle.name: 抗日戰爭
battle.brief: 抗日戰爭自1937年7月展開，日軍在華北與華中投入已列裝的九五式輕戰車，以短砲火力掩護步兵沿鐵路與公路推進。該車配屬裝甲中隊，在開闊地與城鎮外圍提供近距支援。

kit.name: 九五式輕戰車
kit.history: 1935年已列裝的日本輕戰車，抗日戰爭期間配屬在華地面部隊，用於步兵支援與短促機動。

battle.name: 蘇德戰爭
battle.brief: 1941年6月德軍發動「巴巴羅薩」行動，蘇聯紅軍調派T-34/76坦克於東歐前線抵禦裝甲突破。

kit.name: T-34/76坦克
kit.history: 1939年列裝蘇聯紅軍，1941年廣泛配屬於東歐機械化師團。

battle.name: 第二次中東戰爭
battle.brief: 1956年10月，英法聯軍與以色列對埃及蘇伊士運河區發動軍事行動，法國裝甲單位投入已列裝的AMX-13輕型坦克。

kit.name: AMX-13輕型坦克
kit.history: 1953年列裝法軍，1956年配屬於投入蘇伊士運河區的法國裝甲單位。

battle.name: 科索沃戰爭
battle.brief: 1999年3月，北約對南斯拉夫聯盟發動空中作戰，科索沃戰爭隨之展開。美軍投入已列裝的F-16A戰鬥機，執行制空與對地打擊。

kit.name: F-16戰鬥機
kit.history: 1978年已列裝的美軍戰鬥機，科索沃戰爭期間配屬北約空中部隊，用於制空與對地打擊。

battle.name: 護國戰爭
battle.brief: 雲南山區的游擊戰中，護國軍使用M1888步槍進行防禦與埋伏，成功抵禦袁世凱的軍隊。

kit.name: M1888步槍
kit.history: 德國1888年研製的栓式步槍，清末引進，廣泛配用於中國內戰。

battle.name: 愛爾蘭獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 1919年1月在愛爾蘭爆發反英游擊戰，愛爾蘭共和軍在城鄉展開武裝對抗，旨在爭取脫離英國統治。

kit.name: 李-恩菲爾德 Mk III 步槍
kit.history: 該步槍是英國在第一次世界大戰中的主力栓式步槍，於愛爾蘭獨立戰爭期間被英軍與愛爾蘭武裝廣泛使用。

battle.name: 冬季戰爭
battle.brief: 1939年11月底，蘇聯紅軍自東線向芬蘭發動全面進攻，芬蘭軍隊在高寒氣候與森林地形中的卡累利阿地峽、極北及拉多加湖周邊展開防禦，並以索米衝鋒槍配屬步兵班，提供近距離火力支援。

kit.name: 索米衝鋒槍
kit.history: 1931年列裝後，索米衝鋒槍成為芬蘭步兵的主要近戰武器，冬季戰爭期間廣泛配屬於步兵班與滑雪兵，用於近距離火力。

battle.name: 中印邊境戰爭
battle.brief: 1962年10月，中印兩軍在喜馬拉雅山脈東段與西段的高海拔山口交火。中國人民解放軍步兵以已列裝的56式突擊步槍配屬班排，在山地推進中提供近距火力。

kit.name: 56式突擊步槍
kit.history: 1956年列裝的中國制式突擊步槍，1962年中印邊境戰爭期間配屬入藏與新疆方向的步兵部隊，用於山地近戰。

battle.name: 第四次中東戰爭
battle.brief: 1973年10月6日，埃及與敘利亞同時向西奈半島及戈蘭高地進攻，第四次中東戰爭展開。以色列裝甲部隊以已列裝的M60A1巴頓戰車配屬前線，在兩線以105毫米主砲支援步兵穩住陣地並實施反衝擊。

kit.name: M60A1巴頓戰車
kit.history: 1971年以色列自美國接收並列裝的M60A1，1973年配屬西奈與戈蘭方向的裝甲部隊，用於前線火力支援。

battle.name: 阿富汗戰爭
battle.brief: 2001年10月美軍在阿富汗山區展開「持久自由」行動，使用M4卡賓槍、M249機槍等輕武器掃蕩塔利班據點。

kit.name: M4卡賓槍
kit.history: 1994年定型，2001年部署至阿富汗山區，取代M16。

battle.name: 復活節起義
battle.brief: 在都柏林市中心與英軍激烈交火，英軍使用李-恩菲爾德步槍於街道、佔領建築內掃射。

kit.name: 李-恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: 英軍於1907年採用此步槍，裝備步兵與支援單位，廣泛用於一次大戰。

battle.name: 土耳其獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 1919年5月，協約國准許希臘軍於伊茲密爾登陸並向西內陸推進，引發安納托利亞各地的土耳其民族主義抵抗。穆斯塔法·凱末爾於薩姆松登陸後號召成立大國民議會軍，先後於第一次與第二次伊諾努戰役、薩卡里亞河戰役中以步槍與機槍火力遏制希軍推進，最終於1922年大攻勢將希軍逐出安納托利亞，並於1923年建立土耳其共和國。

kit.name: Gew 88步槍
kit.history: 德國於1888年定型的委員會步槍，後續由德軍以Gew 98替換後大量軍援鄂圖曼帝國。鄂圖曼軍於一戰結束後將其移交土耳其國民軍，土耳其共和國成立後繼續改良使用，服役期延伸至1940年代前後，於土耳其獨立戰爭期間為民族主義部隊可見的制式栓動步槍之一。

battle.name: 第二次世界大戰
battle.brief: 第二次世界大戰於1939年9月1日德國入侵波蘭後全面爆發，橫跨歐洲、非洲與亞洲，牽動全球主要強權。此戰期間，德國空軍的梅塞施密特Bf 109戰鬥機自1937年起服役，成為歐洲戰場上的關鍵空中力量。

kit.name: 梅塞施密特Bf 109戰鬥機
kit.history: 做為納粹德國空軍的主力單座戰鬥機，Bf 109在歐洲戰場上肩負制空任務，與盟軍戰機交戰。

battle.name: 芬蘭內戰
battle.brief: 1918 年 1 月至 5 月，芬蘭內戰在芬蘭本土激烈展開，白軍與紅軍在主要城市與鄉村展開激烈武裝對抗，交戰雙方皆大量裝備德國製造的毛瑟 G98 步槍作為主要步兵武器，衝突導致國家政治版圖與社會結構出現劇烈變動。

kit.name: 毛瑟G98步槍
kit.history: 作為德國國防軍的制式步槍，Gewehr 98 在一次大戰期間被廣泛配發至步兵排，並被多國軍隊引進或仿製。

battle.name: 兩伊戰爭
battle.theater: 伊拉克-伊朗邊境與波斯灣
battle.brief: 兩伊戰爭是伊朗與伊拉克於1980年9月在邊境與波斯灣展開的大規模武裝衝突，交戰雙方在沙漠、城鎮與海域展開激烈戰鬥，並動用了包括蘇製T-72主力戰車在內的多種裝備，造成雙方重大傷亡並持續至1988年。

kit.name: T-72主力戰車
kit.history: T-72是蘇聯於1970年代研製的主力戰車，採用125mm滑膛炮與自動裝填機，屬於第三代主力戰車，供蘇聯及多國陸軍使用。

battle.name: 伊拉克戰爭
battle.brief: 伊拉克戰爭是2003年以美國為首的多國聯軍對伊拉克發動的軍事行動，旨在消除薩達姆·侯賽因政權的大規模殺傷性武器威脅並推翻其政權。3月20日地面部隊突破伊拉克防線，佔領巴格達。期間，美軍主力戰車M1艾布拉姆斯（正式型號M1）在實戰中展現強大防護與火力，成為地面作戰核心。

kit.name: M1艾布拉姆斯
kit.history: 作為美國陸軍的主戰坦克，M1自1980年起服役，具備先進的複合裝甲與120公厘滑膛炮，為師級單位的突擊與防禦主力。

battle.name: 福克蘭戰爭
battle.brief: 1982年4月2日至6月14日，英國對阿根廷爭福克蘭群島。海獵鷹FRS.1於1980年列裝，從無敵級航母短距起飛，爭的是艦隊上空，不是阿根廷本土。

kit.name: 海獵鷹
kit.history: 垂直短距起降艦載機。福克蘭一戰證明航母還在，但數量少，制空只蓋得住特遣艦隊。

battle.name: 北伐戰爭
battle.brief: 北伐戰爭於1926年7月由國民革命軍發起，旨在消滅北方軍閥、統一中國。戰事跨越華南、華中、華北多省，雙方動員大量兵力與各式武器，其中日製三八式步槍作為步兵主力武器之一，於1910年代已列裝部隊，並在北伐的激烈戰鬥中發揮重要作用。

kit.name: 三八式步槍
kit.history: 三八式步槍是日本陸軍在二戰前的主力步槍，以其可靠性和精確度聞名，被廣泛用於步兵班及前線作戰。

battle.name: 波蘭戰役
battle.brief: 波蘭戰役是德國與蘇聯於1939年9月共同入侵波蘭的軍事衝突，標誌二戰全面爆發。作戰期間，德軍部署四號坦克（PanzerkampfwagenIV）為主力裝甲，實行快速突破與包圍戰術。

kit.name: 四號坦克
kit.history: 四號坦克是德軍在二戰初期的主力中坦，負責支援步兵與對抗敵方裝甲，並參與閃擊戰術的實施。

battle.name: 繼續戰爭
battle.theater: 卡累利阿地峽與拉多加湖畔
battle.brief: 1941年6月，芬蘭在德國支持下對蘇聯發動「繼續戰爭」，在卡累利阿地峽及拉多加湖畔展開激烈戰鬥，蘇聯以T-34坦克為主力突破防線，雙方陷入持久消耗。在漫長的冬季裡，T-34的裝甲與火力令芬蘭防線多次被突破，雙方陷入激烈消耗。

kit.name: T-34坦克
kit.history: T-34是蘇聯在二戰中期部署的主力中型坦克，以傾斜裝甲與76公厘炮提升生存性與火力，成為蘇軍突破防線的骨幹。
